name: Borja Giménez Larraz - § 28 - Am 32
title: REPORT on the housing crisis in the European Union with the aim of proposing solutions for decent, sustainable and affordable housing
part_text: 28. Underlines the need to combat the criminalisation of occupation of vacant housing, especially public properties and properties owned by landlords with multiple residential assets, where such occupation is carried out by individuals unable to afford housing at prevailing market rates; calls on the Member States to encourage the rehabilitation of abandoned or deliberately neglected buildings and stresses the need to coordinate the transformation of degraded and vacant buildings in high-demand areas into diversified public housing, including social housing, solidarity-based leases, and intermediate housing, and ensuring quality and multi-service facilities;
